requirement_text: The homepage of Apollo hospitals system shall serve as the main interface for users.
user_story: As a patient, I want the Apollo hospitals homepage to be the main interface, so that I can start from one place.
technical_task: Design the homepage of the Apollo hospitals system as the main entry point for users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user opens the Apollo hospitals system, when the system loads, then the homepage is shown as the main interface.
Given the homepage, when a user looks for system functions, then they can be reached from it.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The functions reachable from the homepage are not listed.

requirement_text: ATM cabinet cover shall be made of fiberglass for security purposes.
user_story: As a bank operator, I want the ATM cabinet cover made of fiberglass, so that the cabinet is protected.
technical_task: Specify fiberglass as the material of the ATM cabinet cover.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ATM cabinet cover, when its material is checked, then it is fiberglass.
Given the ATM cabinet, when it is delivered, then no cover of another material is fitted.
rationale: Role assumed: bank operator. The security link of fiberglass is stated in the requirement.

requirement_text: System shall restore data if a database crash occurs.
user_story: As an administrator, I want data restored after a database crash, so that no data is permanently lost.
technical_task: Restore the database data when a crash occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a database crash, when it happens, then the data is restored.
Given the data has been restored, when users access it, then it matches the state before the crash.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The restore point is not stated.

requirement_text: The component shall have special diagnostic modes for end of line testing, calibration and input/output value testing.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want special diagnostic modes for end of line testing, calibration and input/output value testing, so that the component can be tested and calibrated.
technical_task: Provide diagnostic modes in the component for end of line testing, calibration and input/output value testing.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component, when end of line testing is performed, then a special diagnostic mode for it is available.
Given the component, when calibration or input/output value testing is performed, then a special diagnostic mode for each is available.
rationale: Role assumed: test engineer.

requirement_text: The solution should be stable and will operate for sustained amounts of time without interruption.
rationale: "Stable", "sustained amounts of time" and "without interruption" are not quantified.
clarification_questions: How long is a "sustained amount of time" of operation?

requirement_text: This allows you to easily spot many types of errors such as appointments with missing encounters encounters with missing appointments missing charges and authorizations or justifications that are required but not done.
requirement_text_raw: This allows you to easily spot many types of errors  such as appointments with missing encounters  encounters with missing appointments  missing charges  and authorizations or justifications that are required but not done.
rationale: The sentence describes a benefit of an unnamed feature and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which feature is "this" and what must it do?
Is this a requirement or a description of a benefit?

requirement_text: The system shall utilize an object store (S3) for storing large video files.
user_story: As a content creator, I want large video files stored in an object store (S3), so that storage scales.
technical_task: Store large video files in an S3 object store.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large video file, when it is uploaded, then it is stored in the S3 object store.
Given a video stored in the object store, when it is requested, then it is retrieved from the object store.
rationale: Role assumed: content creator. What counts as large is not stated.

requirement_text: The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be easy to use. 90\% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'
user_story: As an employee, I want to reserve a conference room easily, so that 90% of users can do so within 5 minutes of using the product.
technical_task: Design the reservation flow so that 90% of users can reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a group of users new to the product, when they try to reserve a conference room, then 90% succeed within 5 minutes.
Given fewer than 90% succeed within 5 minutes, when the results are evaluated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: employee. "Easy to use" is made testable by the 90% and 5 minute figures.

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt data items to prevent unauthorized access, tampering, and eavesdropping.
user_story: As a user, I want data items encrypted, so that nobody can access, tamper with or eavesdrop on them.
technical_task: Encrypt data items to protect them from unauthorized access, tampering and eavesdropping.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data item, when it is stored or sent, then it is encrypted.
Given an encrypted data item, when an unauthorized party tries to read or change it, then it is not readable and tampering is not possible without detection.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Tampering" protection by encryption alone is not guaranteed; the criterion states the intended outcome.

requirement_text: System shall handle over one thousand simultaneous user requests.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to handle over one thousand simultaneous requests, so that it stays responsive under load.
technical_task: Support more than one thousand simultaneous user requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given more than one thousand simultaneous user requests, when they are submitted, then the system handles them.
Given exactly one thousand simultaneous requests, when they are submitted, then the system handles them.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The response time under load is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall identify and generate appropriate event data for each event occurrence.
user_story: As a system operator, I want appropriate event data identified and generated for each event, so that events are recorded properly.
technical_task: Generate the appropriate event data whenever an event occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event occurs, when it is detected, then event data appropriate for the event is generated.
Given two different events, when both occur, then each gets its own event data.
rationale: Role assumed: system operator. What is "appropriate" is not defined.

requirement_text: A list of disputes meeting search criteria must be provided, differentiating by color-coded status.
user_story: As a dispute analyst, I want a list of disputes matching my search criteria with color-coded status, so that I can see the status at a glance.
technical_task: Return the disputes that meet the search criteria and differentiate them by color-coded status.
acceptance_criteria: Given search criteria, when the analyst searches, then a list of the matching disputes is provided.
Given disputes with different statuses, when the list is shown, then each status is displayed in its own color.
rationale: Role assumed: dispute analyst.

requirement_text: System shall enable customers to compare and choose products from the available options.
user_story: As a customer, I want to compare and choose products from the available options, so that I can pick the best one.
technical_task: Provide product comparison and selection among the available options.
acceptance_criteria: Given several products, when the customer compares them, then their details are shown side by side.
Given the comparison, when the customer chooses a product, then the product is selected.
rationale: Role assumed: customer.

requirement_text: User shall be able to render the scene at a minimum of 30 frames per second.
user_story: As a user, I want to render the scene at a minimum of 30 frames per second, so that playback is smooth.
technical_task: Render the scene at 30 frames per second or more.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene being rendered, when the frame rate is measured, then it is at least 30 frames per second.
Given a frame rate below 30 frames per second, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: User details and data should be stored securely in a database provided by the server.
user_story: As a user, I want my details and data stored securely in a database provided by the server, so that they are protected.
technical_task: Store user details and data in a secured database provided by the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given user details and data, when they are saved, then they are stored in the database provided by the server.
Given the stored data, when an unauthorized party tries to read it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The security mechanism is not specified.

requirement_text: The Clinical Task Tracking capability should provide non-repudiation requirements (IN 1.5) that guarantees that the sources and receivers of data cannot deny that they entered or sent or received the data.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the Clinical Task Tracking capability to provide non-repudiation (IN 1.5), so that sources and receivers cannot deny entering, sending or receiving data.
technical_task: Provide non-repudiation (IN 1.5) in the Clinical Task Tracking capability for data entered, sent and received.
acceptance_criteria: Given data is entered or sent, when the action completes, then a record shows the source cannot deny it.
Given data is received, when the receipt completes, then a record shows the receiver cannot deny it.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The mechanism is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall facilitate communication with vendors and authorize them to sell products on the site after quality assessment.
user_story: As a site administrator, I want to communicate with vendors and authorize them to sell on the site after a quality assessment, so that only approved vendors sell.
technical_task: Provide vendor communication and an authorization step that lets a vendor sell only after a quality assessment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vendor, when the administrator communicates with the vendor, then the message is delivered.
Given a vendor that passed the quality assessment, when the administrator authorizes the vendor, then the vendor can sell products on the site.
rationale: Role assumed: site administrator.

requirement_text: Cache shall store relevant intelligence items, expiring after 12 hours or longer if liked by a traveler.
user_story: As a traveler, I want relevant intelligence items cached for 12 hours, or longer if I like them, so that I can see them again quickly.
technical_task: Store relevant intelligence items in a cache that expires them after 12 hours, unless a traveler has liked them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a relevant intelligence item in the cache, when 12 hours have passed and no traveler has liked it, then it expires.
Given a relevant intelligence item liked by a traveler, when 12 hours have passed, then it is kept longer.
rationale: Role assumed: traveler. How much longer liked items are kept is not stated.

requirement_text: The graphics card should have at least 1 GB of VRAM for optimal performance (optional).
user_story: As a user, I want a graphics card with at least 1 GB of VRAM for optimal performance, so that the application runs well.
technical_task: Recommend a graphics card with at least 1 GB of VRAM as an optional hardware specification.
acceptance_criteria: Given a graphics card with at least 1 GB of VRAM, when the application runs, then it performs optimally.
Given a graphics card with less than 1 GB of VRAM, when the application runs, then it still runs, because the requirement is optional.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Optimal" is not measured and the requirement is marked optional.

requirement_text: On cards that are aware of logical channels, the MANAGE CHANNEL commands are only processed by the OPEN and are not dispatched to an Application.
user_story: As a card issuer, I want MANAGE CHANNEL commands processed only by the OPEN and not passed on to an Application, so that channel management stays in the OPEN.
technical_task: Process MANAGE CHANNEL commands in the OPEN on cards that are aware of logical channels and do not dispatch them to any Application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card that is aware of logical channels, when a MANAGE CHANNEL command arrives, then the OPEN processes it.
Given a MANAGE CHANNEL command, when it is handled, then it is not dispatched to an Application.
rationale: Role assumed: card issuer.

requirement_text: For details of the plug housing see figure `` EMC-Filter Housing for station wagons and convertibles '' above.
rationale: The sentence only points to a figure.
clarification_questions: What does the figure "EMC-Filter Housing for station wagons and convertibles" show that must be implemented?
Is the figure part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall be able to create a consultation request by entering symptoms, uploading reports, and defining the request mode (offline/appointment).
user_story: As a patient, I want to create a consultation request with my symptoms, uploaded reports and a request mode, so that a doctor can respond.
technical_task: Provide a consultation request form for symptoms, report upload and a request mode of offline or appointment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the consultation form, when the patient enters symptoms, uploads reports and chooses a request mode, then the request is created.
Given the request mode, when the patient chooses it, then offline and appointment are the available options.
rationale: Role assumed: patient.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed to be interactive and provide fast updates.
rationale: "Interactive" and "fast updates" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "interactive" mean in testable terms?

requirement_text: System shall support wholesale import of Bath data from external data centers to prevent data loss.
user_story: As a data manager, I want a wholesale import of Bath data from external data centers, so that no data is lost.
technical_task: Support importing the Bath data in bulk from external data centers.
acceptance_criteria: Given Bath data in an external data center, when the import runs, then all the data is imported.
Given the imported data, when it is compared with the source, then no data is missing.
rationale: Role assumed: data manager.

requirement_text: The product shall ensure that only supervisors can enter a caller’s schedule.
user_story: As a manager, I want only supervisors to enter a caller's schedule, so that schedules are controlled.
technical_task: Restrict entry of a caller's schedule to supervisors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supervisor, when the supervisor enters a caller's schedule, then it is saved.
Given a user who is not a supervisor, when the user tries to enter a caller's schedule, then it is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "caller's".

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create unverified (anonymous) avatars or aliases.
user_story: As a user, I want to create unverified anonymous avatars or aliases, so that I can take part without revealing my identity.
technical_task: Allow users to create avatars or aliases that are not verified.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user creates an anonymous avatar or alias, then it is created without identity verification.
Given an anonymous avatar or alias, when it is viewed, then it is not linked to a verified identity.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: Users shall select the relevant performa category, fill the form, and submit it.
user_story: As a user, I want to select the relevant performa category, fill in the form and submit it, so that my performa is recorded.
technical_task: Provide a performa form with a category selection and a submit action.
acceptance_criteria: Given the performa page, when the user selects a category, then the matching form is shown.
Given the filled form, when the user submits it, then it is submitted.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: This component is essentially relevant to keep the environment temperature of certain telematic components in a safe temperature range.
rationale: The sentence states relevance but no behaviour, and the components and range are not given.
clarification_questions: What must the component do to keep the temperature of certain telematic components in a safe range?
Which components and which temperature range are meant?

requirement_text: A patient whose at least one physiologic data type is specified to be under monitoring chooses to report their physiologic data.
user_story: As a patient under monitoring, I want to report my physiologic data, so that my care team can follow my condition.
technical_task: Let a patient with at least one physiologic data type under monitoring report physiologic data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with at least one physiologic data type under monitoring, when the patient chooses to report data, then physiologic data can be entered.
Given a patient with no physiologic data type under monitoring, when the patient looks for reporting, then reporting of physiologic data is not offered.
rationale: Role stated: patient under monitoring. The second criterion follows from "whose at least one ... is under monitoring".

requirement_text: Maintaining the database will be facilitated by a commercial database and the application server.
rationale: The sentence describes a design choice and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the commercial database and application server provide for maintenance?
Is this a requirement or a design decision?

requirement_text: Information about a certain person will be restricted to what is available on the employee pages of the TU/e Encyclopedia.
user_story: As a visitor, I want information about a person limited to what is on the employee pages of the TU/e Encyclopedia, so that only published information is shown.
technical_task: Limit person information to what is available on the employee pages of the TU/e Encyclopedia.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person with an employee page in the TU/e Encyclopedia, when information about the person is shown, then only information from that page is shown.
Given information that is not on the employee pages, when information about the person is shown, then it is not included.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor.

requirement_text: User shall be prompted to sign in again and grant permissions if they do not provide access to their account details, ensuring the app has the necessary information.
user_story: As a user, I want to be asked to sign in again and grant permissions when I did not give access to my account details, so that the app has the information it needs.
technical_task: Prompt the user to sign in again and grant permissions when access to account details was not given.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user did not provide access to their account details, when the app needs them, then the user is prompted to sign in again and grant permissions.
Given the user has granted access, when the app needs the account details, then no extra prompt is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: If a windscreen compensation to fulfill AGMR-1190 is needed, maybe a compensation similar to the (S) MPC specification in FKT_CB-252 could be used.
rationale: "If ... maybe ... could be used" is a suggestion, and the referenced specifications are not given.
clarification_questions: Is the windscreen compensation required or only a possibility?
What do AGMR-1190 and FKT_CB-252 require?

requirement_text: If the password meets the criteria, system shall prompt "Password Changed".
user_story: As a user, I want to see "Password Changed" when my new password meets the criteria, so that I know the change worked.
technical_task: Display the message "Password Changed" when a new password meets the password criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new password that meets the criteria, when the user submits it, then "Password Changed" is displayed.
Given a new password that does not meet the criteria, when the user submits it, then "Password Changed" is not displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The password criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: Updated user accounts with corresponding roles shall be reflected in the system.
user_story: As an administrator, I want updated user accounts and their roles to be reflected in the system, so that permissions are current.
technical_task: Apply changes to user accounts and roles in the system as soon as they are saved.
acceptance_criteria: Given an updated user account, when the update is saved, then the system reflects it.
Given an updated role, when the update is saved, then the user's permissions reflect the role.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator.

requirement_text: The diagnostic operations on the CPN by an operator shall be performed in accordance with rules protecting the users' privacy.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want diagnostic operations on the CPN by an operator performed according to rules that protect users' privacy, so that privacy is kept.
technical_task: Apply privacy-protecting rules to every diagnostic operation an operator performs on the CPN.
acceptance_criteria: Given an operator performs a diagnostic operation on the CPN, when it is carried out, then it follows the privacy rules.
Given a diagnostic operation, when it would break the privacy rules, then it is not carried out.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The rules themselves are not given.

requirement_text: The system shall employ encryption for all privacy-sensitive data at rest to ensure both security and basic functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want privacy-sensitive data encrypted at rest, so that it is secure while the system still functions.
technical_task: Encrypt all privacy-sensitive data at rest.
acceptance_criteria: Given privacy-sensitive data at rest, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted privacy-sensitive data, when an authorized function reads it, then the system works with it normally.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Basic functionality" is read as the system still working.

requirement_text: The passport management website must be available 24 hours a day.
user_story: As a citizen, I want the passport management website available 24 hours a day, so that I can use it any time.
technical_task: Keep the passport management website available for 24 hours a day.
acceptance_criteria: Given any hour of the day, when a user opens the passport management website, then it is available.
Given a full day, when availability is reviewed, then the website was available for 24 hours.
rationale: Role assumed: citizen. No downtime allowance is stated.

requirement_text: The system shall allow the user to modify the date preference set of an already submitted meeting response.
user_story: As a meeting participant, I want to change the date preference set of a meeting response I already submitted, so that I can correct my preferences.
technical_task: Allow editing of the date preference set of a meeting response that was already submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted meeting response, when the user modifies its date preference set, then the change is saved.
Given a modified date preference set, when the response is viewed, then it shows the new preferences.
rationale: Role assumed: meeting participant.

requirement_text: User shall be able to see an error message if the system is low on resources.
user_story: As a user, I want to see an error message when the system is low on resources, so that I know why it may slow down.
technical_task: Show an error message when the system runs low on resources.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is low on resources, when the user is using it, then an error message is shown.
Given the system has enough resources, when the user is using it, then no such error message is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The resource threshold is not stated.

requirement_text: The solution should implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted electronic protected health information is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.
user_story: As a security officer, I want security measures that detect improper modification of electronically transmitted electronic protected health information until it is disposed of, so that tampering is noticed.
technical_task: Implement integrity measures so that any improper modification of transmitted electronic protected health information is detected until the information is disposed of.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic protected health information transmitted electronically, when it is improperly modified, then the modification is detected.
Given the information has not yet been disposed of, when it is checked, then its integrity can still be verified.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer.

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt sensitive data (patient information, prescriptions) at rest and in transit.
user_story: As a patient, I want my sensitive data, such as patient information and prescriptions, encrypted at rest and in transit, so that it stays private.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data (patient information, prescriptions) both when stored and when transmitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given patient information or a prescription, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given patient information or a prescription, when it is transmitted, then it is encrypted.
rationale: Role assumed: patient.

requirement_text: FTSS shall wait for the ICP to signal that it has completed initialization before suspending the application for memory re-alignment.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall (3.3.5.36) wait for the ICP to signal that it has completed initialization before suspending the application for memory re-alignment.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FTSS to wait for the ICP to signal that initialization is complete before suspending the application for memory re-alignment, so that the ICP is ready.
technical_task: Make FTSS wait for the ICP's initialization-complete signal before it suspends the application for memory re-alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ICP has not yet signalled completed initialization, when FTSS is about to suspend the application, then FTSS waits.
Given the ICP has signalled completed initialization, when FTSS proceeds, then it suspends the application for memory re-alignment.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to export data to other formats (e.g., CSV, PDF).
user_story: As a user, I want to export data to other formats such as CSV or PDF, so that I can use it elsewhere.
technical_task: Offer export of data to formats including CSV and PDF.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the system, when the user exports it as CSV, then a CSV file is produced.
Given data in the system, when the user exports it as PDF, then a PDF file is produced.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "E.g." means other formats may exist.

requirement_text: User shall have a registered email linked to the software.
user_story: As a user, I want a registered email linked to the software, so that I can be contacted and verified.
technical_task: Require a registered email address to be linked to each user of the software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user of the software, when the account is set up, then a registered email is linked to it.
Given a user without a registered email, when the user tries to proceed, then the user is asked to register one.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of "shall have".

requirement_text: Enter the appropriate parameters such as the date of service and click 'Search' to bring up a list of all invoices (claims) matching the requested parameters.
requirement_text_raw: Enter the appropriate parameters  such as the date of service  and click 'Search' to bring up a list of all invoices (claims) matching the requested parameters.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to enter parameters such as the date of service and click Search to see all matching invoices (claims), so that I can find a claim.
technical_task: Provide a search with parameters such as date of service that lists all invoices (claims) matching them.
acceptance_criteria: Given search parameters such as the date of service, when the user clicks Search, then a list of all invoices (claims) matching the parameters is shown.
Given parameters that match no invoice, when the user clicks Search, then the list is empty.
rationale: Role assumed: billing clerk.

requirement_text: It shall be possible to modify the CT whenever any of this information is changed by using a CT update primitive in a synchronous and atomic manner.
requirement_text_raw: It shall (3.2.2.2.3) be possible to modify the CT whenever any of this information is changed by using a CT update primitive in a synchronous and atomic manner.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want to modify the CT with a CT update primitive whenever the information changes, in a synchronous and atomic manner, so that the CT stays consistent.
technical_task: Provide a CT update primitive that modifies the CT synchronously and atomically whenever the information it holds changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the information in the CT changes, when the CT update primitive is used, then the CT is modified.
Given the CT update primitive is running, when it modifies the CT, then it does so synchronously and atomically.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The solution de-identification capability should include: Internet Protocol (IP) address numbers.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want the de-identification capability to include IP address numbers, so that they are removed from shared data.
technical_task: Add Internet Protocol (IP) address numbers to the identifiers handled by the de-identification capability.
acceptance_criteria: Given data containing an IP address number, when it is de-identified, then the IP address number is removed.
Given de-identified data, when it is reviewed, then no IP address number remains.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to authenticate to the application using their Radford University username and password.
user_story: As a student, I want to authenticate with my Radford University username and password, so that I can sign in with my existing account.
technical_task: Support authentication with Radford University usernames and passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid Radford University username and password, when the user signs in, then the user is authenticated.
Given an invalid username or password, when the user signs in, then authentication fails.
rationale: Role assumed: student.

requirement_text: The product shall be able to be installed in any operating environment within 2 days.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be able to be installed in any operating environment within 2 days.'
user_story: As an administrator, I want the product installable in any operating environment within 2 days, so that deployment is quick.
technical_task: Make the product installable in any operating environment in 2 days or less.
acceptance_criteria: Given any operating environment, when the product is installed, then the installation is completed within 2 days.
Given an installation that takes longer than 2 days, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator.
